pictures.author: Stuart Yeates
pictures.observed: South facade: grey granite, three window tiers, projecting arched entrance with paired conical turrets, slate roofs/dormers/chimneys, tall green-roofed small turret, square clock tower with corner cones, clock faces and circular crown.

pictures.author: Daniel Kraft
pictures.observed: West facade: three broad stepped gables, tall end turrets, upper supported cylindrical bartizans, pale multi-pane windows, stone string courses and granite surround to the broad entrance. Garden wall/landscaping stay separate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Balmoral Castle: full connected mapped castle and five height-tagged integral parts, open rear courtyard, pale granite main residence with slate roof ranges and stepped gables, conical/bartizan turrets, south arched entrance porch, small green-roofed southeast turret and tall clock tower with corner cones and round crown. Keep the separate estate offices/outbuildings, gardens, walls, fountain and all unrelated buildings as context.
